description: CV expander for SHAPE, giving voltage control of its threshold, hold time, release and hard gate switch

params.text: Attenuverter on the threshold CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the hold time CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added
Attenuverter on the release CV, -100% to +100%, and at 0% when the module is added

inputs.text: Shifts the gate threshold on SHAPE, ±10V covering the whole 60dB range with the attenuverter fully open, added to the GATE knob and clamped to -60dB to 0dB
Shifts the hold time on SHAPE, ±10V covering the whole 300ms range with the attenuverter fully open, added to the SUSTAIN knob and clamped to 0ms to 300ms
Shifts the release time on SHAPE, ±10V covering the whole 0.1 to 4 second range with the attenuverter fully open, added to the RELEASE knob and clamped to that range
Puts SHAPE into hard gating whenever the voltage here is above 1V, whatever the HARD GATE button is set to

notes: The module does nothing unless SHAPE is immediately to its left.
Every attenuverter is at 0% when the module is added, so the three CV jacks do nothing until one is turned up.
SHAPE ignores the expander entirely while its bypass button is on.
The dots either side of the X in the title fade from white to amber once SHAPE is found on the left.

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to -60 to 0V.
